name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: A second friend's server for converted plays. When two friends hold the same title and one converts it for a viewer, the other is now listed in the playlist as a standby: a player that stops getting video from the first server moves to the other at a segment boundary and plays on from its buffer. The standby converts nothing until a player asks it, and stopping the play frees both servers. A new play whose chosen friend does not answer within 8 seconds starts on the next friend holding the title instead of failing. Both are active with "pick the best copy automatically" on, and always on a server that may not convert; this server never steps in to convert a friend's title itself. The standby is offered only for converted H.264 (MPEG-TS) plays of copies with the same length and sound language and no subtitle track selected. Checked with a real hls.js player in headless Chromium and three-server container runs; not yet verified on physical TV or phone players.
